Looking at Example 1 (2024-06-26):
- History: prices declining from 74.07 → 67.80 (last 18 days)

- True outcome at day 1: 66.50
- Difference: +0.30 (model too high by 0.30)

Day 1: model 66.80 vs true 66.50 (model +0.30)
